entities.summary: Amalendu Guha was a performers & entertainers in Imphal (1924-01-30, Imphal – 2015-05-07) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
